releases.body:
Threadforge 1.0.14 updates the Browser and makes orchestrator work easier to follow.

- Replace Thread mode with Browser after Editor, retain the sidebar Browser and pinned sidebar views, and expand Chat to installed coding providers. Add compact browser controls, full/beside and page split views, persistent tabs/groups, private windows, search/home settings, Downloads, history, bookmarks/import, an encrypted local password manager, compatible unpacked extensions and built-in ad/tracking filtering. Open ChatGPT in Browser instead of built-in image generation.
- Add provider-neutral rendered browser snapshots/actions/screenshots and separately permitted Developer/CDP inspection, plus local element/region annotation and temporary style adjustment. Public-site access is granted per tab/origin; private tabs are excluded.
- Add project filtering and scoped Clear conversation to Agent Chat. Display actual worker counts, assigned tasks, providers and terminal locations in coordinator terminals, Dashboard and Progression. Fix prefixed Georgian worker requests, Codex long session metadata and historical exact-session resume. Reduce repeated launch probes and use filesystem wakeups with a polling fallback.
- Switch active Claude/Codex/OpenCode/Pi terminals between saved accounts using a fresh conversation and bounded task handoff after confirmed previous-process exit. Preserve worker/team authorization and budget; reject replay and stale process observations. Show remote monitor/name/status/disclosure/+ and server labels on repositories; select the exact newly registered folder.
- Add 51 renamed palettes without duplicating existing colors, refine outline icons and Voice close alignment, preserve browser sign-in during disposable-cache cleanup, and prune stale caches asynchronously with final shutdown cleanup.

Windows x64 release contains only the NSIS installer and its matching updater/checksum assets. No portable executable.

Validation: one clean complete suite passes 2,416 assertions across 384 files, with zero failures and one existing Windows symlink skip. TypeScript, zero-error lint, all source builds, compiled payload/native branding and installer/update integrity checks pass. Runtime was built/tested at `8b2655ce77268b87fdcbbfc601610e5ea36755fa`; tag `v1.0.14` includes only a corrected static inspector at `bb179f301cf339c82ae88669577a34d40cf2ae16`, with unchanged application/package/build-hook source and matching compiled files.

Native installed UI, real-account worker/chat/account switching, Google sign-in persistence, extensions/downloads, final Quit cache cleanup and real SSH acceptance remain user-run. Provider-internal conversations require observation or explicit sharing. Safe isolated cache warm-up currently supports Claude/Codex; full Remote Workspace hosting requires Linux, Node.js 20+ and systemd. Embedded sign-in/extension APIs and ad filtering have website/runtime limits. The OSS Scanner tab is a provider audit workflow, not Anthropic's hosted scanner service.


## Thread Toolbox

The Toolbox ZIP contains the application payload from the original release above, without rebuilding or running it. Install it through Thread Toolbox; the original downloads are also retained.

# ThreadNote 0.1.1

ThreadNote now uses the approved Thread Space v1.0 gold `TN` icon throughout the
application and its Windows packages. Startup keeps the existing animation and
4.4-second timing, with the decorative sparks removed.

## Changes

- Replaced the application/menu/About/empty-state mark, startup logo, favicon,
  window/tray/shortcut icon, and installer/uninstaller icon resources.
- Added an outlined SVG master, transparent 16–1024px PNG exports and a multi-size
  Windows ICO. Builds reject stale icon exports.
- Restricted Windows packaging to production bundles so old local smoke-test
  screenshots and logs are excluded.
- Preserved navigation pictograms, configurable interface themes and user-selected
  workspace icons. AEGIS assets and code are unchanged.

## Downloads

- **Threadnote-0.1.1-setup.exe**: Windows x64 installer.
- **Threadnote-0.1.1-portable.exe**: standalone Windows x64 executable.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt**: SHA-256 checksums for the binaries and installer metadata.

Installed builds keep notes under `%APPDATA%/threadnote/` by default. Portable
builds use `ThreadnoteData` beside the executable. Settings → Data can select
another location. These builds use the project's existing unsigned configuration.

## Validation

- 528 tests passed across 58 test files; ESLint, TypeScript and production builds
  passed. All generated brand resources match the SVG master.
- The packaged version is 0.1.1. All 19 production build/migration files and the
  runtime ICO match their sources; old smoke-test outputs are excluded.
- Application, installer and portable executable resources contain all seven TN
  icon frames and report product version 0.1.1.0.
- Installer metadata sizes/SHA-512 and downloadable SHA-256 checksums are verified.

Native desktop UI checks are excluded by the browser-only verification policy.

Source commit: b2bb2b55564b5fca269a0be62e7fd77511401783.

# ThreadVoice v0.1.1

Windows x64 maintenance release with the Thread Space brand update and corrected startup navigation.

## Changes

- Adopted the approved Thread Space v1.0 **TV** monogram and **#7548F6** violet palette in the
  control panel, floating widget, startup screen, window/tray icons, setup and uninstaller.
- Replaced the old glow and waveform artwork with a transparent geometric mark; updated startup
  animation artwork and removed decorative sparks, preserving the 4.4-second intro, Skip intro and
  reduced-motion behavior.
- Startup now opens **Home**, including when the API key is missing or the keyboard hook is unavailable.
  Settings remains available through explicit navigation.
- Added a vector master and reproducible PNG/ICO exports, resource checks and focused startup regressions.
- Removed obsolete brand artwork from incremental builds.

## Install or update

Download **ThreadVoice-Setup-0.1.1.exe** and run the installer. It installs for the current user and
creates desktop and Start menu shortcuts. Node.js is bundled. Installing over v0.1.0 preserves settings
and history. Configure your OpenAI API key in **Settings → Connection** if needed.

The installer is unsigned. Dictation and voice conversations require an internet connection and your
own paid OpenAI API access. Uninstalling preserves settings and history.

## Validation

- All 155 automated tests passed, including startup and animation regression coverage.
- TypeScript type checking and generated brand-resource checks passed.
- A fresh Windows x64 NSIS installer was built successfully; emitted and packaged brand-resource
  checks passed. The packaged app contains version 0.1.1 and the corrected Home startup route.
- Installer/app executable versions, update-metadata file size and SHA-512 checksum were verified.
  Release assets include the installer, blockmap, update metadata and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Full interactive UI verification remains incomplete because the agent's in-app browser timed out.
No desktop UI was automated.

Built from commit: 8343ba4499fd04306839a205fc70edce61e3040b

ThreadAccount 0.3.3 განაახლებს აპის ბრენდულ აიქონს დამტკიცებული Thread Space Icon Design System v1.0-ის მიხედვით.

## ცვლილებები

- ახალი **TA / #E7315A** ბრენდი: დაკეცილი გეომეტრიული ჩარჩო, #090B10 შიდა ბლოკი და თეთრი მონოგრამა.
- ვექტორული SVG მასტერი, ცხრა გამჭვირვალე PNG ზომა და შვიდი ზომის Windows ICO.
- განახლებული სათაურის ზოლისა და workspace-ის ლოგოები, favicon, Windows executable-ისა და installer/uninstaller-ის აიქონები.
- ყველა PNG/ICO ექსპორტი build-ის წინ ავტომატურად იქმნება SVG მასტერიდან.

## ჩამოტვირთვა

Windows-ისთვის გამოიყენეთ `ThreadAccount-0.3.3-Setup.exe`. ინსტალაციის გარეშე გაშვებისთვის ხელმისაწვდომია `ThreadAccount-0.3.3-portable.exe`.

განახლებისას ჯერ დახურეთ ძველი აპი. ფაილების SHA-256 საკონტროლო ჯამები მოცემულია `SHA256SUMS.txt`-ში.

## შემოწმება

TypeScript/Vite build, Node ტესტები, გამჭვირვალე PNG/ICO ექსპორტები და შეფუთული Windows EXE/ASAR ბრენდული რესურსები შემოწმებულია. 32/64px წაკითხვადობა და UI-ის მუქი/ღია თემები შემოწმებულია ბრენდინგის სამუშაოს ფარგლებში. Desktop UI არ გაშვებულა.

Threaduninstal v0.2.2 adds an uninstall wizard with persistent application icons, recovery backups for product registry keys and individual values, deeper leftover scanning, and the requested utility modules.

- Desktop apps: interactive uninstall, batch queues, forced cleanup, Safe/Moderate/Advanced scanning, and CSV export.
- Windows Apps, Startup Manager, Hunter Mode, and installation monitoring.
- Compact Claude-style interface with 11px body text, warm selection, Phosphor navigation icons, the supplied app logo, and ThreadForge-style dropdowns.
- Background icon loading, cached/debounced search, and monitor writes only when the log changes.
- Registry recovery preserves value types and unrelated/newer data. Oversized recovery manifests are rejected before cleanup.

Download and extract **Threaduninstal-v0.2.2.zip**, then open `Threaduninstal.exe`. The standalone EXE is also available. Close the older app before opening the new version.

Requires 64-bit Windows 10/11, .NET Framework 4.8, and Windows PowerShell 5.1 for Windows Apps. No installer, subscription, or network connection is required for the app. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Validation: 43 isolated self-tests, source build, headless WPF layout/templates, real read-only app inventories, and browser preview checks. Hunter path matching is tested; real window dragging remains manually unverified. An initial backup test encountered a filesystem replacement error; full subsequent suites passed, and its report is retained.

This is an independent application, not full Revo Pro parity. Advanced scanning is bounded and reports incomplete coverage; access errors, differently named leftovers, other user accounts, and unsupported registry data may be missed. Recovery restores leftovers/settings, not application binaries. Cross-volume folder moves are refused and leave originals in place. See the README for scope and limits.

# Threadplan 1.0.0

First GitHub release of Threadplan for Windows x64 and Android: offline tasks, habits, calendar and JSON backups with the shared redesigned interface.

## Downloads

- **Windows installer:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-windows-x64-setup.exe`. Installs for the current user and downloads Microsoft Edge WebView2 if it is missing.
- **Windows portable:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-windows-x64-portable.zip`. Extract and run `Threadplan.exe`; WebView2 must already be installed.
- **Android:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-android-preview.apk`. Android 7.0/API 24 or newer; ARM64 and x86_64; package `com.threadplan.app`, version 1.0.0, build 10.
- **Checksums:** `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all three packages.

Windows binaries are unsigned development builds. Android is a release-mode build signed with the existing local preview/debug key; it is not a Play Store submission.

## Included

- Tasks with notes, priorities, categories, date/time scheduling, recurrence, search, filters, completion and restore; Today and calendar views.
- Habits with schedules, quantitative goals, history, streaks and statistics.
- Local English/Georgian quick-add parsing with an editable review form.
- Android task/habit reminders, reminder diagnostics and Today/Habits home-screen widgets.
- Windows Tauri 2/Rust shell with native SQLite and reviewed JSON backup import/export.
- Shared appearance settings: themes, text size, button/navigation/icon colors, local background images, six background effects, opacity, blur, glass and interface scale.
- Optional Windows ThreadVoice task dictation using the existing ThreadVoice profile and the user's OpenAI API account. Android voice input uses an installed on-device model.

## Data and upgrades

Windows retains `com.threadplan.desktop` and stores its database at `%APPDATA%\com.threadplan.desktop\threadplan.db`. Schema 8 and existing forward migrations are preserved. No database reset or new migration was introduced for this release.

Export a JSON backup before moving between installations. Existing Electron/browser profiles remain in their original storage; transfer through the reviewed JSON import flow. JSON import replaces records after confirmation. Backups are not encrypted. Android OS automatic backup is disabled.

## Validation and limits

Source commit: `1ab097ffd214513bae6d70614dc56c5672cf69bd`.

Release validation includes TypeScript, ESLint, 121 shared tests, 9 Rust tests, 2 Windows native SQLite integration tests, 2 Android widget JVM tests, web/Android exports, Windows installer build and Android APK build/signature verification.

Native WebView2 launch, installer/dialog interaction, Android launch/widget/reminder delivery, physical-device behavior and real-microphone transcription remain unverified for this release under the project's browser-only UI rule. Windows reminder delivery, notification navigation, background scheduling and offline speech remain pending. Interface labels remain English; there is no cloud sync.
